name: cruma-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for the Cruma tunnel agent.

plugins.name: cruma
plugins.description: Install the Cruma tunnel agent and publish a dev server or a folder. A skill only: it asks before installing Cruma or connecting it to Claude Code.

plugins.name: cruma-local
plugins.description: Cruma with its local MCP server bundled: the plugin connects `cruma mcp` itself, with no extra setup. For this marketplace only; the plain `cruma` plugin is the skill-only one.

plugins.name: cruma-cloud
plugins.description: Optional: Cruma's hosted MCP server for your Cruma account (plan, account tunnels, sites). Asks you to sign in. Not needed for local tunnels.
